description: This file defines an interface for building ExternalMessage objects, including methods for setting headers, payloads, authorization, enforcement, and other metadata related to external messaging in a connectivity service.

classes.name: ExternalMessageBuilder
classes.description: An interface providing builder methods for constructing ExternalMessage objects with customizable headers, payloads, security, and metadata.

methods.name: withAdditionalHeaders
methods.description: Adds individual headers to the builder, identified by key-value pairs.

methods.name: withAdditionalHeaders
methods.description: Adds multiple headers to the builder from a map.

methods.name: withHeaders
methods.description: Replaces the entire header set with the provided headers.

methods.name: withText
methods.description: Sets the payload to a text string and updates payload type to TEXT.

methods.name: withBytes
methods.description: Sets the payload to a byte array and updates payload type to BYTES.

methods.name: withBytes
methods.description: Sets the payload to a ByteBuffer and updates payload type to BYTES.

methods.name: withTextAndBytes
methods.description: Sets both text and byte array payloads, updating payload type to TEXT_AND_BYTES.

methods.name: withTextAndBytes
methods.description: Sets both text and ByteBuffer payloads, updating payload type to TEXT_AND_BYTES.

methods.name: withAuthorizationContext
methods.description: Associates an AuthorizationContext with the message.

methods.name: withTopicPath
methods.description: Associates a TopicPath with the message.

methods.name: withEnforcement
methods.description: Associates Enforcement data with the message; supports null to disable enforcement.

methods.name: withHeaderMapping
methods.description: Associates HeaderMapping data with the message; supports null to disable header mapping.

methods.name: withSourceAddress
methods.description: Adds a source address indicating where the message was received from.

methods.name: withSource
methods.description: Associates a Source object indicating where the message was received from.

methods.name: asResponse
methods.description: Marks the message as a response message.

methods.name: asError
methods.description: Marks the message as an error message.

methods.name: withInternalHeaders
methods.description: Attaches internal headers related to the signal that created the external message for error handling.

methods.name: withPayloadMapping
methods.description: Defines payload mapping rules for this message.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the final ExternalMessage object based on configured parameters.
